purpose: Proposed staged migration sequence (task §49-51). Design-only; no stage has been implemented.
guidingPrinciple: Avoid a big-bang rewrite. Substitute the identity substrate underneath unchanged consumer logic, one Headroom phase at a time, each with its own targeted regression before moving to the next.

stages.name: Introduce nodeId alongside legacy nodeKey
stages.description: Add Option D's nodeId (+ structuralPath/occurrenceOrdinal metadata) to every StructuralNode, computed at parse time. Zero consumer changes yet - nodeKey remains authoritative for all existing callers.

stages.name: Dual-run invariant comparison
stages.description: Build both the legacy index and the new occurrence-safe index from the same parsed nodes; diff node count, reachable-occurrence count, parent-child ownership, source spans, reference-resolution results. Legacy output is a diff target for understanding blast radius, never a constraint on what counts as correct in the new index.
stages.risk: Low - read-only comparison, not yet load-bearing.

stages.name: Migrate structural consumers, in dependency order
stages.description: 2A (index itself) -> 2B discovery -> 2D context retrieval -> 2E/3E coverage-audit and semantic-coverage router/reconciliation -> 2G amendment/operative-state -> 3A IR provenance -> 3B semantic compiler tools -> persistence layer. Each consumer repointed from label-keyed lookups to nodeId-keyed ones; singleton-assuming call sites updated to handle the now-explicit multi-match case.
stages.risk: Medium - the highest-severity consumers (semantic/tools.ts, pass-d-reconcile.ts, persistence.ts) require the most careful before/after comparison.

stages.name: Remove authoritative legacy nodeKey-as-map-key usage
stages.description: nodeKey/sectionRef remain present as display fields only; no code path treats them as a unique lookup key any more.
stages.risk: Low once Stage C is complete for all consumers.

stages.name: Known-package regression sequence
stages.description: Synthetic adversarial identity tests -> existing Phase 2A suite -> FWRG -> LSB -> CONMED -> DSGR structural regression -> DSGR semantic safety regression.
stages.risk: Gate - must pass before Stage F.

stages.name: Scorer / reconciliation semantic-match correction (SEPARATE FUTURE WORKSTREAM)
stages.description: Coverage credit requires semantic correspondence, not merely topical/descendant proximity - addresses the 14-16 false-credit cases Phase 3F.1.1 found. Explicitly NOT bundled into the structural-identity implementation phase.
stages.risk: Not scoped by this ADR; a distinct future phase.

stages.name: New unseen-package validation (Phase 3F.2)
stages.description: Only after both Stage E and Stage F have independently gated green, and the zero-dangerous-omissions gate is met.
stages.risk: Not authorized by this ADR; explicitly out of scope.

dualRunRecommendation.scope: Stage B only - not a permanent dual-parser architecture (which ADR §19 explicitly rejects as a permanent design)
dualRunRecommendation.discardedAfter: Stage B - retained only as migration evidence, not an ongoing architecture

legacyAdapterPolicy.ifUsed: must be explicit and named as legacy; one-way (new nodeId -> legacy label-shaped nodeKey string for any not-yet-migrated caller, never the reverse); never treated as authoritative by new code; scheduled for removal once the consumer inventory is fully migrated
legacyAdapterPolicy.prohibition: legacy nodeKey must never remain the hidden canonical identity behind a nodeId-shaped wrapper

expectedChangesNotRegressions: previously-merged contexts splitting apart into their correct distinct occurrences
reference resolution returning multiple candidates where it used to silently return one
golden/fixture outputs changing where the old output was demonstrably a corrupted merge
compatibilityRiskClassification.genuineRegressionDefinition: any output change for a document/section that had ZERO duplicate-key involvement before and after - provably should be impossible under Option D (a non-colliding node's nodeId construction is a strict superset of information, never a different answer for the non-ambiguous case) and must be release-blocking if observed

cacheInvalidationMechanism.proposed: STRUCTURAL_INDEX_VERSION constant, bumped once at Stage A/C, participating in stage cache keys (structureOutputHash already includes charStart, so it is already more correct than the identity scheme it caches output of), persisted-artifact schema version tags, and historical-compatibility tags.

persistenceMigration.reasoning: DocumentNode's parentId is already a real FK (correct shape). Only persistStructuralNodes' stableKey FORMULA needs the disambiguating component (mirroring nodeId's construction) - no new column, no new model, no Prisma migration strictly required.
persistenceMigration.optionalFutureAddition: An explicit, queryable 'which physical occurrence' debug column would be additive and optional, not required for correctness.

contaminationCheckForFutureImplementatio: grep the diff for dsgr/fwrg/lsb/conmed (case-insensitive) outside test/script/doc paths; manually review any conditional branching in stage-structure.ts/structural-index.ts for logic keyed on a literal section number or document name rather than a general structural property.
